question: Does a band that widens with sqrt(time), recalibrated weekly on the four prior weeks, score better than the frozen Cycle Navigator daily bands on the same issue clock and data?

model.P0: last hourly close fully closed at or before T0
model.sigma: sample std of the last 168 hourly log returns ending at P0
model.h_k: hours from T0 to the end of UTC day k
model.band: P0*exp(+-z_q*sigma*sqrt(h_k)); families: range (day low/high) and close
model.z: q-quantile of needed z over completed asset-days of the 4 prior ISO weeks (proxy issue Monday 08:00Z), >=40 rows else 8 weeks else seed

issue_clock: T0 = first introduction of the original CN weekly freeze path along verified main first-parent history using Git committer timestamp as an availability proxy. The separately frozen Challenger issuance has its own issuance_first_main_utc and cannot retrospectively score any asset-day whose scored_from_utc precedes it (ABSTAIN_PRE_ISSUANCE). Never rebuild original issuance at score time. First HTTP delivery remains UNKNOWN.

scoring.primary: mean CLOSE interval score at alpha=0.2 over identical paired matured asset-days A vs CN source-issued daily RANGE band evaluated against close (a proxy comparison, not proof CN issued a close forecast). Separate A-all calibration stats and paired A/CN scores; never mix denominators.
secondary: Full-day RANGE containment A q80 vs CN source-issued range, on same paired complete hourly days
Close-in-band A/CN on paired complete days
Mean width A/CN and prior-week-close-centered equal-width CN benchmark (#2118), on same clock/asset/day
A calibration: empirical coverage q50/q80/q95 for range and close, separately labelled A-only
scoring.cluster: ISO week, BTC+ETH up to seven complete UTC days; at least eight paired asset-days (same original A/CN) and an A/CN non-tied weekly primary score make a valid confirmatory cluster. MISSING and TIE weeks are skipped.

design_selection_disclosure: The estimator/window were selected among 9 alternatives on W39-W46 retrospective/simulated data, N=90 asset-days; W46 itself was selection-exposed, not independent holdout. Any W46 score is descriptive, not proof of forward edge.

code.ci: .github/workflows/data-architecture-gate.yml step 'Validate Task2 Challenger A sqrt-time volatility band'

weekly_operation: Two governed phases on existing owner workflow: (1) after original CN freeze first enters main, run ISSUE once using current eligible PIT hourly data and source/clock proof, store and merge immutable frozen Challenger JSON on main as soon as possible after first-main CN freeze; every scored day started before first-main issuance is ABSTAIN_PRE_ISSUANCE; no later reissuance or backfill. (2) only after days mature, run SCORE, which reads original first-main JSON and checks source ancestry; write score alongside settlement. Both integration and public site producer are separate, reviewed, no additional schedule; absence of issuer yields ABSTAIN.

observation_integrity.range_and_close_day: All expected hourly bars from ceiling(T0) to UTC day-end must exist exactly once. Minimum six bars remains a lower bound, not permission for gaps.
observation_integrity.missing_hour: ABSTAIN day, no range or close score, not imputed.
observation_integrity.calibration: Exclude any prior-week asset-day with an incomplete expected hourly census.

source_integrity.immutable_issuance: Original Challenger issuance must remain byte-identical to its first main Git blob; late arrival is not a retroactive issuance and all already-started asset-days are ABSTAIN_PRE_ISSUANCE. Score only originally issued forecasts from their later availability clock.
source_integrity.authoritative_clock: First-parent refs/heads/main Git commit committer time, NOT independent external delivery confirmation.
source_integrity.data_quality: Source hourly files may be revised; the issued bands MUST NEVER be recreated from later CSV during scoring; complete daily UTC census required.
source_integrity.public_site: Site Prognose Challenger A is SHADOW/PENDING until a separately reviewed public producer proves original source first-main issuance and readback. The site never promotes this model to official.
